gen-gf-sniglet-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling back in, giving the headings a quiet, level beat with no flashes of weight. Be Vietnam Pro, a plain sans, runs on strokes like bent steel rod.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-merriweather-sans: Sniglet ends its strokes without curling them back. Make it small and you lose nothing, since it has no hairlines to squint at, while Merriweather Sans brings sturdy, large-looking words in sans-serif form.
gen-gf-sniglet-general-sans: Sniglet leads with a distinctive, commanding look, its terminals stopping short of curling back in. And General Sans, a plain sans, offers a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend, with lowercase that rises high.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-orbit: Rounded, quirky and a bit commanding, Sniglet lets its terminals stop short of curling back in. And Orbit, a sans-serif, floats each character apart with a rope-like consistency, which makes the two feel like a loud friend beside a composed one.
gen-gf-sniglet-manrope: Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling back in, a quiet, level beat. Manrope, in sans-serif form, holds one pen width throughout and keeps a bright gap at every curve's mouth, so its lowercase barely steps down from the capitals.
gen-gf-sniglet-switzer: Approachable is the mood here, and Sniglet gets there with terminals that stop short of curling back in, level and quiet. Switzer, a plain sans, brings wire-like letterforms and a lofty waist line, so it does the finer work.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-bespoke-sans: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges between them and an opening like a sprung paper clip. And Bespoke Sans, a sans-serif, leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, so paragraphs read sharp and refined.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-abeezee: Stencil-cut and loud, Snowburst One has bridges between its letters and openings like a sprung paper clip. And ABeeZee, a sans-serif with a neon-tube thickness, keeps a long page approachable, its terminals finishing well clear of each stem.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-aldrich: Stencil bridges, bold and loud: that's Snowburst One. It carries the expression with its paper-clip openings, while Aldrich, a sans-serif with flat, unmodulated line weight, handles the steadier work.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-alexandria: Alexandria is a sans with wide open c terminals and a lofty body with short stems above and below. And Snowburst One, a stencil sheet with wide bridges, does its best work at expressive, bold display.
